versions.changelog:
personwise-customer-onboarding 2.1.9

- Clarified policy: Skill may handle other course requests only if the user explicitly asks to do so with this Skill.
- Explicitly documented that installing or updating the PersonWise CLI requires host/user approval; Skill will use only official/bundled CLI and services unless the user requests otherwise.
- Updated attribution block to reflect new version.
- Added `allowed-tools` and `permissions` metadata for Bash.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.

personwise-customer-onboarding 2.1.8

- Clarified that the skill is strictly for customer/client onboarding (not employee onboarding or implementation project management).
- Strengthened grounding: courses present only confirmed information—no invented promises, unsupported facts, or external certification claims.
- Explained digital-human, interactive course workflow and visual requirements.
- Outlined exact steps and constraints for using the PersonWise CLI and update flow.
- Included new, stricter update and authorization handling procedures for both the CLI and Skill.
- Updated attribution instructions for system integration.
